issue_request: FHIR-44139 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I clarification request asking the Multi-Version Implementation Guides section to say that most implementation guides target a single version of FHIR, avoiding ambiguity with an IG's own version or dependency versions.
initial_application: The Jira application comment cites git master b9cfa263c9. That commit changed source/implementationguide/implementationguide-notes.xml so the target sentence now reads "Most implementation guides target a single version of FHIR".
additional_context: ImplementationGuide is active in source/fhir.ini, so the checked notes source is current build input. The adjacent ImplementationGuide.fhirVersion comment still says "single version", but it is inside an element whose short and definition explicitly scope the value to FHIR specification version(s), so it does not preserve the ambiguity raised by the ballot comment. FHIR-I minutes for 2024-03-04 confirm the Persuasive 9-0-0 vote, and no Zulip issue-key discussion was found that changes the conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source files were edited because the requested clarification is already present in the authoritative narrative source and the surrounding current source is semantically clear.
